notes: The 30.071-point user report predates this source change; no platform score is available for this candidate.
Counts remained cn=8001, en=11000, mixed=7332 and limit=20 in every timing group.
Both old/new plain EXPLAIN output/filter annotations are equal for the inspected count queries; only runtime predicate dispatch changes.
Original-script tokenization slightly regressed while query time improved; no tokenizer or construction source was modified, and construction was not remeasured.

Extra mysqltest --ps-protocol failed at DROP DATABASE before reaching retrieval. The old binary reproduces that failure and also fails at SELECT 1. These checks are not counted as passes; SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE inside normal regressions passed.
Original benchmark reports contain a documentation git_head predating the source commit because measurements preceded commit; candidate compiled source corresponds to source_commit.
Debugger snapshots identify execution paths only; no CPU percentages are inferred from four attaches.
